rules.scope: suppress a required candidate when every grounded span is either weak evidence owned by a normalized operation span or a false exact mention that decomposes into an operation span followed by the prefix of another independently exact full-field span
rules.rationale: Longest lexical matching can create a false field such as mean_volume across the analytical operator mean and the real field volume_total; typed span ownership must precede field obligation emission.
rules.failure_condition: The phrase mean volume_total independently grounds both volume_total and schema field mean_volume.
rules.conflict_policy: Standalone exact/alias/value/semantic evidence remains protected; decomposition requires an explicit typed operation and a distinct exact owner field with adjacent spans.
